answer.message: Here are the relevant official guidance cards.

cards.title: Check before accepting work
cards.summary: Student work permissions depend on your course and circumstances. Check your own permission and your university's term dates before accepting work. The Student visa overview lists self-employment among restricted activities; exceptions and other employment conditions need qualified advice.
actions: Check your eVisa or decision letter for your work condition.
Ask your university adviser about term time, dissertation periods, multiple jobs and any proposed freelance work.

answer.notice: General information and source navigation only. No individual immigration, legal or financial eligibility decisions. Do not enter passport numbers, account details or other sensitive information.
answer.handoff: For an individual decision, ask your university international student advice team. Quote the support reference if reporting a problem with this app.
